channel.title: The Daily Digest
channel.description: One top story from each of my chosen publications, updated daily.

item.title: NYT: Trump Said to Have Secretly Used Military Jet to Leave Turkey Amid Threats
item.description: President Trump hid in an airport catering container and was taken to a military jet for a secret flight out of country after the NATO summit last month.

item.title: NPR: The secret economics inside the new Planet Money board game
item.description: From Nobel Prize-winning research to the Laffer Curve, Scabby the Rat, Veblen's peacock, and more — the economic ideas and inside jokes hiding throughout Planet Money's new board game.

item.title: BBC News: Trump hid in catering truck in secret plane swap over Iran threat, reports say
item.description: The US president was part of a ruse where reporters were falsely told he was with them on Air Force One leaving a Nato summit in Turkey.

item.title: The Guardian: The great silence: why haven’t we found any aliens yet?
item.description: Given the size and age of the universe, it should be full of species with technology far more advanced than our own. So where are they? • The summer issue of the Long Read magazine is out now. Click here to order During…

item.title: Al Jazeera: East Libya military intelligence chief killed in car bomb
item.description: Prime minister of the Eastern Libyan government condemns killing of Major-General Fawzi al‑Mansouri.

item.title: Ars Technica: Ars Live: Ross Scott discusses the Stop Killing Games movement
item.description: Our discussion takes place live on August 11 at 3 pm ET.

item.title: WIRED Backchannel: Elon Musk, Sam Altman, and the Misreading of Science Fiction
item.description: Beyond Elon Musk’s interpretation of The Odyssey, Silicon Valley leaders have often misunderstood classic books like Foundation and The Hitchhiker’s Guide to the Galaxy. It’s evident in their tech.

item.title: WIRED Science: Seedless Blackberries and Cherries That Grow on Bushes Vie to Be the Future of Food
item.description: Startups and Big Ag are using Crispr gene editing to create crops that taste better and grow on a hotter planet. But will they find a market?

item.title: WIRED Business: The Rise of the 1 am Job Interview
item.description: An AI interview is increasingly the first step of a hiring process. Since there’s no human on the other end, candidates are scheduling them whenever—even deep into the night.

item.title: The New Yorker: The Doulas Who Help Us Die
item.description: In an aging America, thousands of people have adopted a new vocation: supporting others as they confront the end of life.

item.title: New York Mag The Cut: Anne Hathaway Would Like You to Know Her Pregnancy Is Real, Thanks

item.description: And access to a huge outdoor space from a crisp one-bedroom in Chelsea.

item.description: The City-County Council voted in favor of a halt on approval of new data centers through 2027. The post Indy councilors hit pause button on data centers appeared first on Mirror Indy .
